title: Practice 5: Фёдор Достоевский · Ёлка и свадьба

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: А будете ли вы ___ (любить / полюбить) меня, милая девочка, когда я приеду в гости к вашим родителям?
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Нужно заметить, что Юлиан Мастакович был немножко ___ (толстенек).
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Я протеснился сквозь толпу и увидел чудную красавицу, для ___ (который) едва настала первая весна.
exercises.why: «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53.

exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Юлиан Мастакович поспешил поднесть к ___ (нос) платок, который держал, за один кончик, в руках.
exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.

exercises.q: Я протеснился сквозь толпу и увидел ___ (чудная красавица), для которой едва настала первая весна.
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: День был пасмурный, начиналась изморось; я пробрался за ___ (толпа) в церковь и увидал жениха.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Это был маленький, кругленький, сытенький человечек с ___ (брюшко), весьма разукрашенный.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: ___ (мочь), восемь аль десять со ста берет.
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Тут ___ (явить / явиться) гувернантка, его маменька, и велела ему не мешать играть другим детям.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Ровно лет пять назад, накануне Нового года, меня ___ (пригласить / приглашать) на детский бал.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Чтоб не ___ (подать / подавать) подозрений, Юлиан Мастакович пошел также в столовую.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.
